## Title
**The Credit Report Audit Kit: check, dispute and freeze your credit yourself (guide + letters + tracker)**

## Short description
Read all three credit reports like an auditor, dispute errors with ready-to-send letters, and freeze your credit. No credit repair company needed.

## Full description
> Credit reports decide loan rates, apartment approvals and sometimes deposits, and they can contain mistakes. This kit turns checking them into a 90-minute job.
>
> **What's inside**
> - **Guide (PDF, 12 pages):** how to get all three reports free from the official site, a line-by-line audit checklist, which items you can dispute and which simply age off (with typical timeframes), how disputes work and what to do if an item comes back "verified", how to freeze your credit at all three bureaus for free, what to do about identity theft, how utilization works, and a 90-day plan.
> - **Three letter templates:** dispute to a credit bureau, dispute to the lender, and a goodwill request for an accurate late payment.
> - **Tracker (.xlsx):** an account-by-account audit across Equifax, Experian and TransUnion; a dispute log that shows when each answer is due and flags overdue ones; a utilization calculator that tells you exactly how much to pay down to reach your target; and a freeze record.
>
> **Honest note:** no one can legally remove accurate, current negative information. This kit helps you fix what's wrong and understand the rest.
>
> Instant download. US credit reports. Educational content, not legal or financial advice.

## Benefit bullets
- Do yourself, for $9, what credit repair companies charge monthly for.
- Know in five minutes whether an item is worth disputing.
- Ready-to-fill letters, based on the structure of FTC and CFPB sample letters.
- Freeze your credit at all three bureaus in about 15 minutes, free.
- See exactly what to pay before your statement closes to lower reported utilization.

## FAQ
**Will this raise my score?** It can't promise a number. Fixing real errors and lowering utilization are two of the most direct things you can do; results depend on your report.
**US only?** Yes; it's built around the three US bureaus and US law.
**Do I need to pay for a credit report?** No. The guide shows you the free official route.
**Format?** PDF + .xlsx (Excel, Google Sheets, Numbers).

## Compliance notes for posts promoting this
- Never promise a score increase or "delete bad credit". Say "find and dispute errors".
- Don't call it "credit repair" in ads; that term triggers platform policies and CROA concerns. "Credit report audit" is accurate.
